title: Show a priority badge on each ticket card
body:
Agents can't tell urgent tickets apart on the board. Each card should show its priority.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every ticket card on the board shows a badge with its priority: Low, Medium, High or Urgent
- [ ] Urgent badges are red, the others are grey
- [x] Tickets without a priority show no badge
- The badge text is readable by screen readers

## Notes

Design mock is in Figma. Tasks:

- [ ] ask design for the red shade
- [ ] check the card component

comments.body: Could we also sort the column by priority? Maybe a separate ticket.
